provider: CUHK Gender Studies Programme current undergraduate curriculum and course listing
note: The CUHK 2026 admission page links the Gender Studies Programme's current Bachelor of Social Science curriculum. The Programme page states a 54-unit Major Requirement comprising 21 units of Required Courses and 33 units of Major Elective Courses, but its Required table labels the listed block as 18 units and its Elective table labels the pool as 36 units. This supplement therefore publishes all 62 unique current course codes and titles for read-only planning without assigning per-course credits or constructing a graduation rule. The Required block contains five named taught courses plus an Internship or Thesis I and Thesis II capstone choice. The Elective table contains 54 options and states that at least 36 units are to come from the list, with a maximum of 6 units of non-GDRS courses; the text conflicts with the 33-unit Major Elective summary and is retained only as a manual-review note. GDRD3002 is preserved verbatim because both the current Programme table and the department's Course Listing publish that code. Hash markers are removed from normalized course codes and retained in the requirement group for the 23 marked outside-department courses; the current page states that marked courses and GDRS courses at level 2000 or above enter the Major GPA calculation. Courses remain subject to annual offering. This is a partial read-only planning list and must not produce a graduation completion percentage.
